preamble: The voiceless retroflex fricative [ʂ] becomes voiced [ʐ] before a voiced obstruent through regressive voicing assimilation. In Russian and Polish, whose hard sibilants ш/sz are retroflex, obstruent clusters agree in voicing with their final obstruent, including across word boundaries when there is no pause, so /ʂ/ surfaces as [ʐ] before voiced stops and fricatives.

examples.note: ш [ʂ] assimilates in voicing to the following б across the clitic boundary
Same regressive assimilation before the voiced clitic бы; may be partial in careful speech
Polish obstruent clusters agree in voicing, including across a word boundary, so sz [ʂ] voices before d
